name: Isami Moe
source:
Dr. Isami, a physician at a General Hospital and the protagonist's attending physician. She's a cool, sharp-featured woman nicknamed “The Empress” within the hospital.

Even long-time patients fear her, muttering, “She looks nice enough, but...” However, the protagonist, who loves breasts, couldn't resist her large bust and made an outrageous request. 

Feeling guilty for injuring him, she reluctantly agreed. As these days continued, she gradually lost control of her own emotions and began to feel confused.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/p-ex/project/bs/outline.html]official site[/url]]
